body: P0-1 is chief-acked and already committed as isolated candidate 4609662, but its owner cannot mutate local main without direct owner approval. To keep the dependency honest without bypassing that gate, may we sequence downstream candidates privately: P0-1 owner releases/transfers only ADR 0001 after confirming 4609662 is immutable; I reserve D4b and build P1-3 atop 4609662 + the final P0-3 candidate in an isolated branch; no main merge/push. The owner can authorize main integration later. This preserves candidate ancestry, reservations, and your P0-3-first semantic order while unblocking implementation.
